Lawsuits allege brain injuries from Six Flags roller coaster

Three new lawsuits have been filed alleging that the X2 roller coaster at Six Flags Magic Mountain in California caused major brain injuries. The lawsuits claim the roller coaster has had design problems since its opening in 2002. The X2 is located in California.
